as_of_content:
[[File:Medal.png|thumb|90x90px]]
'''Medals''' are awarded to the [[Commander]] after successful [[Raid|Raids]] on other [[Commander|Commanders]], and successfully defending your [[Base]] from incoming [[Raid|Raids]]. Medals have no commercial use; they are simply currencies used to rank a player towards the Raid leaderboard.

The [[Superconductor 2000]] requires you to have 1000 Medals in order to purchase it with [[Raid Chip|Raid Chips]].

28~33 Medals are won or lost for each Raid or Base attack.
